investment_theses.thesis: Shipping-driven inflation (Persian Gulf freight shock at 10x baseline) will spike energy and materials commodities through 2026, benefiting DBC (commodity ETF) and crude oil futures over equities.
supporting_signals: CNBC — Supertanker Gulf-to-China charter at $76M, 10x pre-war level; structural supply squeeze from geopolitical risk.
Trump diesel order signals political ceiling on energy prices, but supply-side friction remains real; DXY weakness supports commodity re-rating.
investment_theses.counter_view: Demand destruction from rate hikes + recession fears could collapse commodity prices faster than shipping costs decline; geopolitical de-escalation ends crisis prematurely.
investment_theses.expression: Long DBC (Commodities ETF) or WTI crude futures; hedge with long DXY to capture USD weakness as commodity inflation reprices.

investment_theses.thesis: Federal Reserve hawkish signaling (another hike coming) coupled with Treasury bond auction strength will drive 10-year yields higher before Q4 2026, making long-duration bonds and growth equities underperformers relative to value/dividend.
supporting_signals: CNBC — Fed minutes: another hike coming, no timeline given; market uncertainty creates volatility premium.
Treasury 10-year yield retreated from 24-year high after strong auction, but hike signal contradicts demand narrative.
investment_theses.counter_view: If earnings disappoint (Q3 profits miss consensus), growth stocks may re-rate lower as recession fears spike, crushing yields through flight-to-safety.
investment_theses.expression: Overweight financial sector (XLF) and value (VTV) relative to growth (QQQ); short 10-year Treasury futures or sell TLT; buy IVV call spreads to bet on value rotation.

investment_theses.thesis: Cryptocurrency infrastructure maturation (Coinbase–Deribit, Wells Fargo–Payward, Tether–Kazakhstan cenbank) signals institutional adoption inflection; Bitcoin and Ethereum will outperform traditional equities through Q3 2026 as on-chain credit and stablecoin velocity accelerate.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk — Wells Fargo in talks with Kraken parent Payward; institutional crypto plumbing is live.

CoinDesk — GSR $100M vault business + Tether–Kazakhstan tokenization deal; off-chain credit markets forming.
investment_theses.counter_view: Regulatory crackdown (SEC enforcement) or macro shock (recession, 2026 debt ceiling crisis) could freeze crypto adoption narrative; crypto volatility may spike on geopolitical shock.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC and ETH spot (or 3–6 month perps with 5–10x leverage); overweight crypto-native equities (COIN if public); accumulate stablecoin yield (USDC on Aave or Compound) as base rate.
